title: Module pullback commutes with localization in a containing universe
statement: Let C and D be sites small relative to the coefficient universe W [def-weil-size-convention, def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology], with finite limits. Let U:C → D be continuous and preserve finite limits. Let R and S be sheaves of rings and a:R → U_*S a ring-sheaf morphism. For V in C assume Over.post U is continuous on the slice sites. Write a_V for the restricted coefficient map and assume the global and slice module pushforwards [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] have left adjoints F and F_V. The canonical comparison F_V(L|V) → (FL)|U(V), whose adjunct is the restricted global adjunction unit, is invertible. Its composite with the slice unit equals the restricted global unit. Thus maps from (FL)|U(V) to a module N correspond bijectively to maps L|V → U_V* N, with the correspondence given by composition with the restricted unit. Restriction and localized rings are as in [def-pur-localized-ringed-site]. If U preserves covering sieves, the slice continuity assumption holds.

proof.text: The functor Over.star V sends X to V × X → V and is right adjoint to forgetting the slice. Product comparison U(V × X) ≅ U(V) × U(X) identifies the two composite module right adjoints. Naturality of a along the second projection verifies the coefficient square.

Uniqueness of left adjoints gives an isomorphism between slice restriction followed by F_V and F followed by target restriction. Under the composite adjunction its adjunct is the restricted global unit: compute both units at X using restriction along prod.snd; the equation prodComparison_snd and naturality of the global unit identify the components. Consequently the canonical comparison is that isomorphism.

Precompose with this comparison and apply the slice adjunction to obtain the claimed Hom equivalence. The triangle identity gives its unit formula and injectivity gives the local extensionality criterion. For the final assertion, Over.post U preserves finite limits and coverings; Mathlib isContinuous_iff_coverPreserving supplies continuity.
